metas.name: Son Of
metas.description: An entitled son sues his father for neglecting his duties. The father's powerful response sparks a courtroom battle that teaches the son about responsibility, love, and family.

metas.name: O M Operation Mole
metas.description: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

metas.name: Mayookha
metas.description: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

metas.name: Haiku
metas.description: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

metas.name: Gondhal
metas.description: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

metas.name: Ever After
metas.description: A group of girlfriends arrive at a forest lodge to celebrate, but things take a horrific turn as they realize that the forest is home to bloodthirsty lunatics who perceive themselves to be characters from classic fairy tales.

metas.name: Drones
metas.description: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

metas.name: City Lights
metas.description: Follows two individuals who move from a village to Bengaluru, only to confront the harsh realities of survival in a fast-paced, indifferent city.

metas.name: Anbil Avan
metas.description: A married couple attempts to start a good life together, but unexpected trouble traps them in an unsettling situation that forces them to fight back for their survival.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

metas.name: Janata Bar
metas.description: Mothers, children, sisters, and ordinary revolutionaries frequently make huge personal sacrifices in the fight for the right to live equally under the law. 'Janata Bar' is the story of one such woman who fought for justice.

metas.name: Faati Ne
metas.description: Two dimwit cops must survive the most terrifying night of their lives to win the things that matter most.

metas.name: Mrigaya 1 5
metas.description: Officer-in-Charge Debanjan Dutta of the Kolkata Police and his team face mounting danger while investigating a gruesome crime that shakes their neighborhood. As twists derail the probe, a ruthless gang spreads chaos across the city. With tensions rising and violence erupting, the hunt intensifies.

metas.name: Raghu Dakat
metas.description: A mystical tale of Bengal's defining era, where an unlikely hero transforms into a legendary figure through extraordinary deeds and becomes forever woven into the fabric of cultural memory.

metas.name: You Can See Everything
metas.description: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

metas.name: Wicker
metas.description: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

metas.name: Way Of The Warrior Kid
metas.description: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

metas.name: The Social Reckoning
metas.description: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

metas.name: The Last Temptation Of Becky
metas.description: Now working as a field agent for the CIA, Becky is sent undercover to Poland to infiltrate a family of innkeepers running a tourist venture at The Wolf's Lair, Hitler's WWII bunker. After learning that the father, Wilhelm Reuss, is on a mission to bring about the Fourth Reich, Becky takes matters into her own hands.

metas.name: The Influencer Project
metas.description: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

metas.name: The Hunger Games Sunrise on the Reaping
metas.description: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

metas.name: Rolling Loud
metas.description: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

metas.name: Madden
metas.description: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football's most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

metas.name: Guarding Stars
metas.description: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

metas.name: Breeder
metas.description: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

metas.name: Big Girls Dont Cry
metas.description: Over one transformative summer in rural New Zealand in 2006, 14-year-old Sid discovers desire, identity, and the internet as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.

metas.name: A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

metas.name: The Snare
metas.description: When a high school student is arrested with a small amount of drugs, the police pressure her to become an informant—forcing her to choose between the people she most loves and the future she's worked so hard to create.

metas.name: Appofeniacs
metas.description: When Duke goes on a frenzy of reckless deepfake creations, his callous disregard of consequences shows how, with a few clicks of an app on a phone, anyone can create a deceiving video of an unsuspecting victim and ruin their life… or end it.

metas.name: Pratap
metas.description: A decorated encounter specialist is imprisoned for murder, leading to a journey of self-discovery revealing that his arrest is retribution tied to his past.

metas.name: Party Animals
metas.description: Childhood best friends Mann Patel and Armaan Khanna reunite in Mumbai for a night out that spirals into chaos with romantic complications, escalating fights, and every fix creating more problems.

metas.name: Nanhey Dil
metas.description: Set against the contrasting worlds of Mumbai's slums and elite educational institutions, Nanhey Dil follows the journey of Raghu Jadhav, the young son of a dhobi whose life takes an unexpected turn when he secures admission to a prestigious school. The opportunity comes through Principal Anthony, who believes that every child deserves access to quality education, rega...

metas.name: Kaali Kheti
metas.description: A story of inheritance land, legacy, trauma and the cost of trying to bury the past to grow the future.

metas.name: Drishyam The Conclusion
metas.description: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

metas.name: Delhi 2021
metas.description: The second wave of the deadly coronavirus pandemic is raging in the Delhi NCR region. In the midst of this horror, the lives of disparate individuals intertwine, revealing the intricate web of humanity's struggle and strength.

metas.name: Steps
metas.description: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.
